data.title: Add tags/labels system
data.body:
## Goal

Add a tagging system for organizing bugs beyond just priority and status.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Add `TagAdded { tag: String }` event type
- [ ] Add `TagRemoved { tag: String }` event type
- [ ] `docket tag ID TAG` adds a tag to a bug
- [ ] `docket untag ID TAG` removes a tag from a bug
- [ ] `docket new --tag TAG` creates bug with initial tag(s)
- [ ] `docket list --tag TAG` filters by tag
- [ ] Tags shown in `docket show` output
- [ ] Tags shown in `docket list` output (compact form)
- [ ] Derive tags as a Set in `derive_bug()`

## Context

Currently the only organizational dimensions are priority (3 levels) and status. Tags enable flexible categorization:
- `security`, `performance`, `ux`
- `frontend`, `backend`, `infra`
- `urgent`, `tech-debt`, `enhancement`

This is table-stakes for any task tracker.
